actions.reason: C0001 has coherent multi-modality identity evidence (inflammatory/immune RNA upregulation, PBRM1/VHL depletion, coordinated 3p CNV differences), cross-modal membership support from a median of 3 of 4 modalities with a predominantly positive boundary to C0002, and no technical confounder association. Structure is compatible at the current granularity, though weak silhouette magnitudes and moderate resampling stability leave residual uncertainty. Retain for downstream validation.

C0002 shows a coherent reciprocal molecular profile to C0001 (metabolic upregulation, reduced inflammatory signaling, PBRM1/VHL enrichment, reciprocal 3p CNV differences), cross-modal membership support from a median of 3 of 4 modalities with a predominantly positive boundary to C0001, and no technical confounder association. Structure is compatible at the current granularity, though weak silhouette magnitudes and lower resampling stability (ARI 0.44, PAC 0.81) leave residual uncertainty. Retain for downstream validation.
